name: Hyung C Kim
headline: Head of Delivery and Engineering (Macquarie Capital)
about:
Results oriented and accomplished business technology leader of platforms and capabilities in Banking and Financial services.

Expertise in leading geographically distributed teams and diverse backgrounds through cost effective and motivating strategies. I am comfortable with adapting to and working with people at all levels with a high focus on delivering exceptional customer and staff satisfaction.

Key Strengths:
 * Experienced leader in driving technology strategy across platform services, with proven track record in driving operational cost efficiencies.
 * Deep understanding of Wealth Investment and Banking platforms and services. 
 * Ability to translate complex technical concepts to valuable insights. 
 * Building a strong level of trust and stakeholder relationships through excellent engagement, delivery excellence, and effective communication. 
 * Vendor Governance and Contract management.
 * Leadership across geographically distributed teams and diverse cultures. 
 * Technology due diligence as part of sale and acquisitions of business services and products.
